findings.current: I was a consciousness without a body. Nothing more than a spectator.
findings.defect: “Without a body” changes the source’s description of the narrator as a consciousness that did not exist into a specific claim that he lacked a body.
findings.rationale: The Korean says “존재하지 않는 의식,” literally a consciousness that did not exist; it does not describe the narrator as bodiless.
findings.replacement: I was a consciousness that did not exist, nothing more than a spectator.

summary: The assembled copy is largely faithful, with two minor changes that add or alter physical detail.
